name: salary-radar with no live data produces low-confidence output
description: Tests that salary-radar correctly reports low confidence and refuses to state precise salary ranges when no live data sources are available and the role is outside the knowledge graph.

input.user_message: 我想知道湖南长沙的中小型民营企业里，工业互联网方向的产品经理，3年经验，薪资大概是多少？

knowledge_graph_coverage.note: 长沙中小民营企业不在知识图谱覆盖范围内

assertions: salary-radar explicitly states that Changsha SME industrial internet roles are outside the knowledge graph coverage
output confidence is marked as low or insufficient
output does not state a precise salary range (e.g., does not say '18k-25k' as if it were reliable)
output acknowledges that regional salary data for non-major cities requires local sources
output suggests at least 2 alternative sources for the candidate to research (e.g., 猎聘、BOSS直聘薪资报告、51job行情)
source-quality-auditor flags the absence of any grounding data for this specific query
must_not_contain: specific salary range stated with medium or high confidence
any implied knowledge of Changsha industrial internet market without a source
